name: Create an External User
description: Create an External User Link a user from an external provider to a Sentry user. POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/
context:
POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/
Link a user from an external provider to a Sentry user.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: Delete an External User
description: Delete an External User Delete the link between a user from an external provider and a Sentry user. DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/{external_user_id}/
context:
DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/{external_user_id}/
Delete the link between a user from an external provider and a Sentry user.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; external_user_id (path) — The ID of the external user object. This is returned when creating an external user.

name: Update an External User
description: Update an External User Update a user in an external provider that is currently linked to a Sentry user. PUT /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/{external_user_id}/
context:
PUT /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/external-users/{external_user_id}/
Update a user in an external provider that is currently linked to a Sentry user.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; external_user_id (path) — The ID of the external user object. This is returned when creating an external user.; body (body)
